duas.title: In the morning
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsainā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilaikal-maṣīr
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: In the evening
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning, and by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the Resurrection
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsainā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilaikan-nushūr
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: In the evening: the kingdom belongs to Allah
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ … لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.translation: We entered upon evening and the whole Kingdom of Allah also entered upon evening and praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One Who has no partner with Him. … His is the Sovereignty and Praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything. O Allah, I beg of Thee the good of this night and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of this night and the evil which follows it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from torment in the Hell-Fire and from torment in the grave
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: For protection, three times morning and evening
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَىْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, when Whose name is mentioned nothing on Earth or in Heaven can cause harm, and He is the Hearer, the Knower
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: Going to bed
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika amutu wa ahya
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: Waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu li l-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: The last words before sleep
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.translation: O Allah! I surrender to You and entrust all my affairs to You and depend upon You for Your Blessings both with hope and fear of You. There is no fleeing from You, and there is no place of protection and safety except with You O Allah! I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu Zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa bina-biyika-l ladhi arsalta
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: After wudu
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.translation: I testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the servant of Allah and His Messenger
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: Opening the prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَاىَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.translation: O Allah! Set me apart from my sins (faults) as the East and West are set apart from each other and clean me from sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt (after thorough washing). O Allah! Wash off my sins with water, snow and hail
duas.transliteration: Allahumma, baa`id baini wa baina khatayaya kama baa`adta baina l-mashriqi wa l-maghrib. Allahumma, naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqa th-thawbu l-abyadu mina d-danas. Allahumma, ighsil khatayaya bi l-maa'i wa th-thalji wa l-barad
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: After the salam
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
duas.translation: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: After every prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well.
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: Leaving home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah; there is no might and no power but in Allah
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: Entering the masjid
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah! open for me the doors of Thy mercy
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: Leaving the masjid
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah! I beg of Thee Thy Grace
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: Entering the toilet
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a`udhu bika min al-khubuthi wal khaba'ith
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: If you forgot Bismillah before eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah at the beginning and at the end of it
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: After eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا الطَّعَامَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
duas.translation: Praise be to Allah Who has fed me with this food and provided me with it through no might and power on my part
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: Breaking the fast
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.translation: Thirst has gone, the arteries are moist, and the reward is sure, if Allah wills
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: Setting out on a journey
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
duas.translation: Hallowed is He Who subdued for us this (ride) and we were not ourselves powerful enough to use It as a ride, and we are going to return to our Lord. O Allah, we seek virtue and piety from Thee in this journey of ours and the act which pleaseth Thee. O Allah, lighten this journey of ours, and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, Thou art (our) companion during the journey, and guardian of (our) family. O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee from hardships of the journey, gloominess of the sights, and finding of evil changes in property and family on return.
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: Words added when returning from a journey
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.translation: We are returning, repentant, worshipping our Lord. and praising Him
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: In times of distress
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu Al-`Azim, al- Halim, La ilaha illal-lahu Rabbu-s-samawati wal-ard wa Rabbu-l-arsh il-azim
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: For worry, grief and debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by (other) men.
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: When afflicted by a calamity
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.translation: We belong to Allah and to Him shall we return; O Allah, reward me for my affliction and give me something better than it in exchange for it
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: For debt and provision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your prohibited, and make me independent of all those besides You
duas.transliteration: Allāhummakfinī biḥalālika `an ḥarāmika, wa aghninī bi faḍlika `amman siwāka
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar, the best way to ask forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana `ala `ahdika wa wa`dika mastata`tu, A`udhu bika min Sharri ma sana`tu, abu'u Laka bini`matika `alaiya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir lee fa innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba illa anta
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: Asking forgiveness, said a hundred times in one sitting
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
duas.translation: O my Lord, forgive me, and accept my repentance. Verily, You are the Oft-Returning, the Most Forgiving
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfirlī watub `alayya innaka antat-Tawwābul-Ghafūr
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: Visiting someone who is ill
duas.arabic: لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.translation: Don't worry, if Allah will, it will be expiation (for your sins)
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: Asking Allah to heal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.translation: O Allah, the Lord of the people! Remove the trouble and heal the patient, for You are the Healer. No healing is of any avail but Yours; healing that will leave behind no ailment
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: When stopping at a place
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He has created
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: For guidance, piety, chastity and freedom from need
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.translation: O Allah. I beg of Thee the right guidance, safeguard against evils, chastity and freedom from want
duas.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

duas.title: For a steadfast heart
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.translation: O Changer of the Hearts! Strengthen my heart upon Your Religion.
duas.transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: For beneficial knowledge, and refuge from the Fire
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ حَالِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ
duas.translation: O Allah, benefit me with that which You have taught me, and teach me that which will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge. All praise is due to Allah in every condition, and I seek refuge in Allah from the condition of the people of the Fire
duas.transliteration: Allāhummanfa`nī bimā `allamtanī wa `allimnī mā yanfa`unī, wa zidnī `ilma, al-ḥamdulillāhi `alā kulli ḥālin, wa a`ūdhu billāhi min ḥāli ahlin-nār
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: Congratulating someone on their marriage
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.translation: May Allah bless for you, and may He bless on you, and combine both of you in good (works)
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

duas.title: Seeking protection for children
duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
duas.translation: I seek refuge for the two of you in the Perfect Words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every harmful eye
duas.transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahi-tammati,min kulli shaitanin wa hammatin, wa minkulli'ainin lammah
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: On Laylat al-Qadr
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa, fa'fu 'anni
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Ibn Majah

duas.title: On the Day of Arafah
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Alone, without partner, to Him belongs all that exists, and to Him belongs the Praise, and He is powerful over all things.
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa `alā kulli shai’in qadīr
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: On seeing the new moon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.translation: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ahlilhu `alainā bil-yumni wal-Īmān, was-salāmati wal-Islām, rabbī wa rabbuk Allāh
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

duas.title: When it rains
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.translation: O Allah, make it beneficial rain
duas.transliteration: Allahummaj'alhu Sayyiban nafi`a
duas.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan an-Nasa'i

duas.title: The Talbiyah of Hajj and Umrah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.translation: I respond to Your call O Allah, I respond to Your call, and I am obedient to Your orders, You have no partner, I respond to Your call All the praises and blessings are for You, All the sovereignty is for You, And You have no partners with You
duas.transliteration: Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, Labbaika la sharika Laka labbaik, Inna-l-hamda wan-ni'mata Laka walmulk, La sharika Laka
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: Glorifying Allah, a hundred times a day
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi
duas.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

duas.title: Our Lord, accept from us
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Good in this world and the Hereafter
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Do not burden us
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Do not let our hearts deviate
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Allah is sufficient for us
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
duas.translation: Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: The dua of Adam and Hawwa
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: For prayer, parents and believers
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: For one's parents
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Mercy and right guidance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Increase me in knowledge
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: The dua of Yunus
duas.arabic: لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
duas.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Forgive and have mercy
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: For spouses and children
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: In need of any good
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: Gratitude, parents and offspring
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International

duas.title: For believers who preceded us in faith
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
duas.englishEdition: Saheeh International
